styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, Mughal-era tombs and the old city's bazaars.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Biryani, BBQ and street snacks from dawn to late night.

styles.label: Beaches
styles.blurb: Sea breeze, camel rides and sunset at Clifton.

stays.why: Central and cheap; close to the Empress Market, old bazaars and the colonial-era streets. Basic hotels, busy and noisy.
Near the seafront, Clifton Beach and good restaurants. A safe, easy base for first-timers.
Quiet, upmarket and green, with malls and cafés. Further from the old city sights.
Mid-range hotels and food streets; handy for the airport side of town but far from the sea.

food: Try Sindhi and Karachi biryani, plus BBQ (seekh kebab, tikka) at the food streets in Gulshan and Clifton.
Street snacks: chaat, samosas, gol gappay and bun kebab. Eat where locals queue and where food is cooked hot and fresh.
Seafood near the harbour and Clifton: grilled fish and prawns. Ask the price per kilo before ordering.
Nihari and haleem are breakfast or late-night classics. Many places open early and stay open past midnight.
Drink bottled or filtered water only. Skip ice and raw salads at cheap street stalls if your stomach is sensitive.
more_time: Add a half-day for the Chaukhandi Tombs near Landhi, an old carved-stone cemetery, best with a hired car and driver.
History fans can swap a beach afternoon for Mohatta Palace Museum and the nearby Frere Hall in the old city.
Shop for textiles and handicrafts at the Empress Market area and Zamzama boutiques; bargain politely.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the old city, the seafront and a proper food crawl; add a night for a day trip to the Chaukhandi Tombs.

month_notes: January: coolest month, highs near 24°C and cool nights. Best all-round weather.
February: mild and dry, highs around 27°C. Great for walking the old city.
March: warming to 30°C, still dry. Comfortable mornings and evenings.
April: hot at 32°C and humid; plan outdoor sights for early morning.
May: hot and sticky, highs near 34°C. Stick to air-conditioned sights and evening food streets.
June: hot and humid with a few rain days; sea breeze helps at the beach after sunset.
July: monsoon season, most rain days (about 8) and muggy. Carry an umbrella and expect flooded streets.
August: still rainy and humid, highs near 30°C. Indoor plans are safer.
September: rain eases, still warm and humid at 31°C.
October: hot but drying out at 33°C; evenings get more pleasant.
November: cooling to 30°C and dry. A good shoulder month for sightseeing.
December: mild days near 26°C and cool nights. Excellent for the beach and old city.

climate_guide.summary: Hot, humid coastal climate: long warm season, a short monsoon in July–August, and mild, dry winters.

items.title: Best time: November to March
items.text: Highs of 24–30°C with cooler nights. Ideal for the old city, bazaars and the seafront.

items.title: Hot season April to June
items.text: Highs of 32–34°C with high humidity. Do outdoor sights early; rest indoors at midday.

items.title: Monsoon in July and August
items.text: About 8 rain days each month, often heavy. Streets can flood; keep plans flexible.

items.title: Humid near the sea
items.text: Sticky evenings for much of the year. Light, breathable clothes help.

items.title: Sea breeze
items.text: The coast is cooler and breezier than inland districts; Clifton is pleasant after sunset.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light cotton clothes, a hat and sunscreen; a light layer for winter nights and strong AC; an umbrella for July–August; modest dress for religious sites.

transit.best: Ride apps (Careem, InDrive) for most trips; agree fares for taxis and use the BRT where it runs.

modes.text: No metro or tram. A bus rapid transit (BRT) line runs on some corridors only.
City buses and minibuses are cheap but crowded and confusing for newcomers. Use the BRT where it runs.
Careem and InDrive work widely; Uber coverage is limited. Metered taxis are rare, so agree the fare before you ride.
Driving yourself is stressful. Hiring a car with a driver is common and easier.
Walking is hard outside a few areas. Use a ride for anything beyond a few blocks.
